```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"On September 11, 2001, terrorists demonstrated cruelty.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Terrorists intend to strike the United States to the limits of their power.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Terrorists seek weapons of mass destruction to kill Americans on an even greater scale.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The danger increases when outlaw regimes build or acquire weapons of mass destruction and maintain ties to terrorist groups.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"On September 11, 2001, the American people demonstrated courage and optimism.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Colleagues helped each other in escaping from collapsing buildings.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Policemen, firefighters, emergency medical professionals, public works employees, members of the military, and volunteers ran into burning buildings to save others and undertake a rescue and recovery effort.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Passengers on Flight 93 rushed their murderers to save lives on the ground.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"America's parents and teachers battled their own fears to keep children calm and safe.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Terrorists have learned that Americans will not be intimidated.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Americans will fight terrorists with everything they have.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Americans will prevail in their fight against terrorists.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
